subject: Milestone-led pilot -> contract: proposed MAP & credits
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Emma Shaw <emma@sightlineanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot proposal and milestone plan

Hi Emma —

Great to sync yesterday. As discussed, I built a milestone-led Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties pilot credits, acceptance criteria, and conversion economics to clear checkpoints so your team can evaluate risk-free while we protect unit economics on our side. High-level proposal (attached: Sightline_MAP_v2.xlsx):

1) Onboard & Evaluation (Week 0–2)
   - Deliverables: integration guide + 2 sandbox sessions, sample workload run
   - Credits: 75,000 token-equivalent pilot credits frontloaded on MAP signature
   - Acceptance: baseline QA tests pass (latency under 450ms p50, sample F1 >= 0.82)

2) Performance Validation (Week 2–4)
   - Deliverables: throughput test, KV cache exercise, security review checklist
   - Credits: additional 100,000 credits on validation sign-off

3) Production Ramp & Commit (Month 2–4)
   - If Sightline signs a 12-month commit within 30 days after validation, conversion pricing: 12% discount off published list for $200k ARR commit; 18% discount for $500k ARR commit. Ramp targets and trading of credits are in the attachment.

Other points:
- Free trial extension: +14 days available if MAP is signed (we’ll frontload credits at signature).
- Reporting cadence: weekly pilot-usage-report.csv to be shared every Monday.
- SOC2 & security: we’ll provide SOC2 Type II attestation and a short evidence packet next week.

Next steps: if this looks reasonable, can we get a note from procurement with firm billing terms (Net 30/45) and an expected signature date? Target to sign MAP by Friday 1/29 to keep the onboarding slot in the week of 2/1.

Attachments: Sightline_MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed milestones & pricing matrix)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the acceptance criteria.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

From: Emma Shaw <emma@sightlineanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal and milestone plan

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear runbook. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Can Sightline get more of the pilot credits up front? Our evaluation team wants to run a broader corpus in Week 1.
- Payroll/procurement question: procurement will need the pricing matrix and confirmation of invoice terms (net 30 preferred).
- Legal wants to see the MSA and any redlines early to avoid last-minute delays.

Looping procurement address: procurement@sightlineanalytics.com. Procurement may also request proof of SOC2 if possible.

If you can send an updated MAP with a pricing table and MSA redlines, we’ll review internally and aim to confirm by the end of next week.

—
Emma Shaw
Head of Product, Sightline Analytics
emma@sightlineanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal and milestone plan — pricing options

Quick internal:

Jonas — good plan. A couple of negotiation-friendly adjustments we should offer to help close:

1) Frontload 75k credits at signature (as you proposed) but structure the 100k validation credits as conditional on completing the throughput test within 30 days. If validation slips, credits expire after 60 days.

2) Pricing tilt: propose two formal commit bands in the MAP:
   - Band A: $200k ARR commit -> 12% discount + 6 months of reserved capacity guarantee window
   - Band B: $500k ARR commit -> 18% discount + priority scheduling + dedicated onboarding support

3) Limited-time incentive: if they sign MAP within 7 business days, offer a one-time additional 25k credits applied to first invoice (non-refundable).

4) Trial extension: allow a 14-day free extension but require the MAP signature and a short one-page SOW.

I attach a redline MSA (MSA_redlines.docx) — legal flagged two small SLA items (availability calculation and escalation matrix) which we can accept with minor tweaks. Also attached an updated MAP spreadsheet (Sightline_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the pricing table and acceptance criteria.

If Rishi can confirm the economic floor (margin) on Band A/B, I’ll send this back to Emma with the revised timings.

—
Marissa
Director, Account Strategy
marissa@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Emma Shaw <emma@sightlineanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@sightlineanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal and milestone plan — updated MAP attached

Emma — attaching the revised MAP and MSA redlines per Marissa and legal. Key changes: 

- Credits: 75k frontloaded on MAP signature; 100k released on validation (see acceptance checklist). If validation completes within 30 days we release the 100k; if delayed beyond 30 days credits will be released upon completion but expire after a 60-day window.
- Pricing table: Band A ($200k ARR) = 12% discount; Band B ($500k ARR) = 18% discount. One-time incentive: +25k credits if MAP is signed within 7 business days of receipt.
- Trial extension: 14 days extra, requires signed MAP + one-page SOW.
- Reporting: weekly pilot-usage-report.csv (sample attached) due Mondays.
- Security: SOC2 attestation link (we’ll share full evidence packet by 1/26).

Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-8943
Attachments: Sightline_MAP_v2.xlsx, MSA_redlines.docx, pilot-usage-report.csv

Can procurement confirm Net 30 vs Net 45 for invoicing? Also, if we can get an estimated signature date (target 1/29) we’ll reserve a dedicated onboarding slot for the week of 2/1.

Thanks — happy to review any of the redlines on a 20-minute call.

—

From: Emma Shaw <emma@sightlineanalytics.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal and milestone plan — updated MAP attached

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with what procurement requested. A few quick items from procurement and legal: 

- Procurement confirms Net 30 is fine.
- Procurement requests the MSA redlines in Word (we got the PDF view) — please send the .docx.
- Procurement also asked for SOC2 attestation; they’ll expect the evidence packet but are okay proceeding with the MAP in parallel.

We’ll sign the MAP and aim to return the signed copy by next Wednesday (2/4). Can you confirm a planned pilot start date if we sign 2/4? Also confirm whether the 25k early-sign credit will be honored if we meet the internal sign-by date (we likely will).

Procurement contact: procurement@sightlineanalytics.com
